description:
1st October to 31st October - Breakfast Seva @ Rs 3,000 per day at J J Dharamshala was sponsored by Rtn Deepak Himatsingka (Rs 16,000), Rtn Firoz Kachwalla (Rs 3,500), Rtn PP Rukhsana Khan (Rs 3,500), Rtn Nafisa kachwalla (Rs 3000), Rtn A K Viswanathan (Breakfast & Lunch - (Rs 16,000), President Rtn Hemangini Desai Rs (Rs 3,000), Rtn Vidya Mukund high tea (Rs 2,500) and Rtn Farah Vora (dinner & high tea Rs 10,500)
Project cost Rs 58,000/-
